note: Where Verse looks for legitimate money left on the ground (owner via the treasury brief, 2026-11-04). Legal sources only, each with its own page; nothing deceptive or against a site's terms. tools/found-money.mjs checks every page is reachable before it lists it, runs the live probes, and writes void-live-deploy/treasury/found.json. A value is only ever a number a source publishes (a prize pool, a bounty, a program's stated credit); otherwise it is null and says so. Anything that needs Atom's identity, a sign-in or a card is 'ready to claim'.

verse.facts: Verse (a-to-mind.com) is a public open-source repo (github.com/atomeam/void-loop), runs on Cloudflare's free tiers, sells through Gumroad, has its own X and YouTube, is a one-person US business run by Atom (Florida).

places.title: MissingMoney.com: every participating US state's unclaimed property, searched under A-to-Mind and Atom's own name
places.needs: Atom's legal name and address history (only he may claim his own property)
places.fit: anyone can have it; a search is free

places.title: Florida Treasure Hunt: Florida's own unclaimed property, under the business and Atom's name
places.needs: Atom's legal name; a claim needs his ID
places.fit: Atom is in Florida

places.title: Open class-action settlements that name a service Verse or Atom uses
places.needs: Atom files the claim himself, only for a settlement he actually qualifies for
places.fit: checked against the services Verse uses

places.title: Gumroad balance waiting to be paid out (a $100 minimum before a bank payout, so a small balance can sit unclaimed)
places.needs: Atom's Gumroad login (Payouts page); or GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN on the site so Verse can read sales itself
places.fit: Verse sells on Gumroad

places.title: Abandoned Gumroad checkouts: Gumroad's own abandoned-cart workflow emails people who left a cart
places.needs: Atom's Gumroad login to turn the workflow on
places.fit: Verse sells on Gumroad

places.title: Payment-processor reserves or holds on the Gumroad account (payouts paused by disputes)
places.needs: Atom's Gumroad login
places.fit: Verse sells on Gumroad

places.title: Cloudflare SLA credits after an outage
places.why: Cloudflare's SLA covers Business and Enterprise plans; Verse runs on the free tiers, so there is nothing to claim until it pays for a covered plan

places.title: Unused credits or promo balances already sitting in Cloudflare and GitHub billing
places.needs: Atom's Cloudflare and GitHub logins (Billing pages)
places.fit: the accounts Verse runs on

places.title: Paid subscriptions billed twice or not used (Atom's card statements)
places.needs: Atom's card statements: Verse never reads payment accounts
places.fit: Verse itself pays for nothing yet, so any find is on Atom's side

places.title: AWS Activate Founders: AWS credits for self-funded startups
places.value_note: AWS publishes up to $1,000 in credits for Activate Founders
places.needs: Atom applies with an AWS account and company details
places.fit: self-funded, no institutional funding

places.title: Cloudflare for Startups: credits on the platform Verse already runs on
places.needs: Atom applies with the Cloudflare account and company details
places.fit: Verse runs on Cloudflare; eligibility terms are on the page

places.title: Google for Startups Cloud Program
places.needs: Atom applies with a Google Cloud account
places.fit: AI-first startups get a track; terms on the page

places.title: Microsoft for Startups (Azure credits)
places.needs: Atom applies with a Microsoft account
places.fit: terms on the page

places.title: Vercel Open Source Program (credits for public open-source projects)
places.needs: Atom applies for the public repo
places.fit: the repo is public; credits help only if Verse hosts something on Vercel

places.title: GitHub Sponsors on the public repo: people can fund Verse directly
places.needs: Atom joins GitHub Sponsors (identity, tax form and a bank account)
places.fit: the repo is public and active

places.title: YouTube Partner Program on Verse's own channel, once it is eligible
places.needs: Atom's YouTube login to see eligibility and apply
places.fit: Verse has its own YouTube channel

places.title: X creator revenue sharing on Verse's own X account, once it is eligible
places.needs: the X account's login and payout setup
places.fit: Verse has its own X account

places.title: Federal R&D tax credit (Form 6765), including the payroll-tax offset for qualified small businesses
places.needs: Atom and his tax preparer: Verse does not file taxes
places.fit: building new software can qualify; the preparer decides

places.title: Florida's small-business incentives and programs
places.needs: Atom applies for the business
places.fit: Atom is in Florida

places.title: NLnet / NGI Zero open calls: grants for open internet software
places.needs: Atom writes and submits the proposal under his name
places.fit: open source required; the project must fit a call's theme

places.title: Mozilla Foundation funding programs
places.needs: Atom applies
places.fit: depends on the open call

places.title: Sovereign Tech Agency: funding for open digital infrastructure
places.needs: Atom applies
places.fit: for widely used infrastructure; Verse is not that yet, so this is a watch, not a claim

places.title: Algora: paid bounties on open-source issues
places.needs: an Algora account to submit and get paid

places.title: IssueHunt: bounties on open-source issues
places.needs: an IssueHunt account

places.title: Gitcoin Grants rounds for open-source projects
places.needs: Atom applies with a wallet

places.title: Online hackathons on Devpost that fit Verse's skills
places.needs: Atom registers and submits as the entrant
places.fit: online, open, a theme Verse already builds

places.title: Domain parking or sale for domains Atom holds and does not use
places.needs: Atom's registrar login to list unused domains
places.fit: a-to-mind.com is in use, so only other domains count

places.title: Licensing Verse's own public datasets (the outcome exam, the Versus tower measurements)
places.needs: Atom lists them as the seller
places.fit: low confidence: the data is public already, so a buyer would pay for curation and updates
